rendered: The authors used the FTIR band at 871 cm^−1, indicating the existence of PVDF[1]. This band is the CH2 bending vibration: bending vibration of CH2[2]. It was present in the cathode rejects and in the powder recovered by room temperature filtration, but the band was absent for the reclaimed powder filtered at high temperature (hot filtration), which the authors took as evidence that the PVDF binder had been removed: at 871 cm^−1 for the reclaimed powder that was filtered at high tem-[3] . The answer is therefore the band at 871[4] cm-1, absent for the hot filtration condition.
